infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Sai ki Family uses the photos and videos you select to add your profile picture or attach media to a community post, event or business listing. For example, you can share a photo from a Sai Mandir visit in an experience post.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Allow Sai Family to recognize your speech for search.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow Sai Family to use the microphone for voice search.

plugins.photosPermission: Sai ki Family uses the photos and videos you select to add your profile picture or attach media to a community post, event or business listing. For example, you can share a photo from a Sai Mandir visit in an experience post.
plugins.cameraPermission: Sai ki Family uses your camera when you choose to take a photo or video, for example to attach a Sai Mandir photo to an experience post or update your profile picture.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Sai Family to use the microphone for voice search.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Sai Family to recognize your speech for search.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Sai Family to use your location to fill event and directory coordinates.
